source: WFP Emergency Report No. 28 of 1996 (19 Jul 1996) - Liberia section
processing_notes: Source states: '1.4 Six people died of cholera in June in Monrovia out of 183 reported cases (also 112 cases of measles were reported).' - interpreted as 183 sCh cases, 6 deaths. Interpreted as 183 sCh and 6 deaths in Monrovia (Montserrado), June 1996. Consistency: DHA HSR 26 (row 1197) gives 3,300 cases/31 deaths for June+July from five referral facilities, implying the epidemic took off in July (row 998 alone has 754 for 16-24 July); the June figure here is lower than the sum of facility rows 996 (27 May-3 Jun, 94, partly May, St Joseph's 'cholera-like' diarrhoea) and 997 (22-28 Jun, 135), so it is probably an incomplete MoH notification count - kept as a separate stream, confidence 0.6. Subset of row 1197 period - do not sum; overlaps rows 996/997 - do not sum. Provincial subset - do not sum with national row (JHU 1996 annual 8,922). Agent 2 batch 7 Q9.
retracted_reason: Agent 2 self-retraction: WFP 'June 1996 Monrovia 183 cases/6 deaths' is inconsistent with DHA weekly counts already held (row 997: 135 cases in 22-28 June alone; row 996: 94 in 27 May-3 Jun) and with DHA HSR 26 (row 1197, 3,300 Jun-Jul); kept the DHA facility series, dropped the WFP monthly figure as an incomplete notification count

source: WHO Liberia Mission Report 11-28 August 2003 - Annexes (WHO disasters repository 11229)
processing_notes: Source states: 'WHO pooled the data from the OPD clinics operated by Merlin and the ORT corners operated by MSF /F. Cartoon has counted approximately 78 deaths from cholera since the beginning of the outbreak.' - interpreted as 78 deaths. retracted_reason: Agent 2 self-retraction: superseded by the row from the main WHO mission report (metadata 130, Monrovia deaths estimated 143 to 31 Aug 2003, which includes the corpse-removal count plus CTC and outreach deaths); the annex figure (~78 to 25 Aug) is an earlier partial count of the same series
